about.intro_content: Prof. Fang-Jian Zhou is a Professor in the Department of Urology at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou, specialising in the surgical treatment of genitourinary tumours including prostate cancer, kidney cancer and bladder cancer.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Zhou's group has developed modified surgical techniques now widely adopted by peers, including a modified approach to prevent complications related to stoma and ileoureteral anastomosis in ileal conduit diversion, and a modified neourethral anastomosis technique for orthotopic neobladder reconstruction. His group has also focused on nephron-sparing surgery to preserve kidney function in patients with small renal masses, and has researched the molecular mechanisms of bladder cancer metastasis, including the role of Nkx2.8 in epithelial-mesenchymal transition.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Fang-Jian Zhou

items.question: Does Prof. Fang-Jian Zhou accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to urologic cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Zhou's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Zhou specialises in the surgical treatment of genitourinary tumours, including prostate cancer, kidney cancer and bladder cancer.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Does Prof. Zhou perform kidney-preserving surgery?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Zhou's team emphasises nephron-sparing surgical techniques for small renal masses, aiming to preserve kidney function while treating the tumour.

items.question: What surgical innovations has Prof. Zhou developed for bladder cancer?
items.answer: Prof. Zhou's group developed modified techniques for ileal conduit diversion and orthotopic neobladder reconstruction that reduce complications and have been widely adopted by other surgeons.
